title: 呈现路由
summary: 同一轮回答在纯文本、契约组件和 iframe 沙盒里各长什么样；声明不合法或 JSON 还没写完时，宿主降级，不提前挂载。
summaryEn: How one turn looks as plain text, a contract component, or an iframe sandbox, and how the host degrades when the declaration is illegal or the JSON is still incomplete.
asks: 这一轮该用纯文本、契约组件，还是 iframe 沙盒？不合法时怎么降级？
asksEn: Should this turn be plain text, a contract component, or an iframe sandbox — and how does an illegal turn degrade?

links.when: 助手住在哪，不是这一轮用哪种表面来呈现
links.whenEn: where the assistant lives is not which surface this turn renders on

links.when: 半截包是未闭合的路由 JSON，不是语音 token 的打字机
links.whenEn: a partial packet is an unclosed route JSON object, not a speech-token typewriter
